Looking for warehousing solutions near you? TradeSpace offers warehouses for rent in Calgary, providing flexible industrial rental space to meet your needs. Our shared warehouse services include short-term leasing options and shared warehouse space, perfect for businesses seeking a flexible warehouse solution. Whether you're looking for industrial shop space or shared warehouse facilities, TradeSpace has the solution for you. Explore our industrial warehouse space for rent today and find the perfect space for your business.

Tailored Warehouse Solutions for Your Business

‍ Our state-of-the-art warehouse facility offers flexible, self-operated storage solutions designed to accommodate your specific business requirements. Whether you need a temporary space to expand your operations or a long-term solution to streamline your supply chain, our warehouses provide the versatility and convenience you need.

Key Features:

Managed or Self-Operated Options: Choose the level of control that best suits your business needs.

‍ Flexible Lease Terms: Customize your lease to align with your evolving business demands.

‍ Convenient Shipping and Receiving: Efficiently manage your inbound and outbound shipments with our on-site facilities.

‍ Forklift and Labor Services: Access essential equipment and support to optimize your warehouse operations.

Professional Workspaces for Your Growing Business

‍ Our modern office spaces offer a variety of options to suit your team's needs, from private offices to shared coworking areas. Experience the benefits of a professional work environment without the overhead costs associated with traditional office leases.

Spacious and Well-Appointed Offices: Enjoy a comfortable and productive workspace.

‍ Flexible Lease Terms: Choose a lease that aligns with your company's growth plans.

‍ Coworking Spaces: Connect with like-minded professionals and foster collaboration.

‍ All Amenities Included: Benefit from essential services and features at no additional cost.

Seamless Fulfillment Solutions for Your E-commerce Business

‍ Our fulfillment center provides scalable, customizable solutions to streamline your e-commerce operations. With our expertise in logistics and warehousing, we offer efficient pick, pack, and ship services tailored to meet your growing business needs.

Scalable Fulfillment Solutions: Easily adjust your fulfillment capacity to meet demand.

‍ Customizable Services: Tailor our services to your specific requirements.

‍ Efficient Order Processing: Benefit from our streamlined workflows and advanced technology.

‍ Reliable Delivery: Ensure timely and accurate delivery of your products to customers.
